Process

How It Works

A four-step pipeline from raw sensor data to actionable water quality insights.

01

Collect

Water-quality parameters are collected from environmental monitoring sensors and data sources.

02

Analyze

The system processes and normalizes the 14 water-quality parameters for model input.

03

Predict

The Random Forest machine-learning model evaluates the data and classifies water quality.

04

Monitor

The system displays the predicted water-quality condition with confidence scores and parameter summaries.

Technology

Powered by Machine Learning

The system uses a Random Forest Classifier trained on historical water-quality data to deliver accurate, real-time predictions across three quality classes.

About

About the System

This is an AI/ML-based water quality monitoring application developed as a college AIML project. The system analyzes multiple environmental parameters and predicts water quality using a trained machine learning model.

By combining real-world sensor data with a Random Forest classifier, the system provides actionable water quality assessments classified as Good, Moderate, or Poor.
